behavior: An animated shallow-water hunter that runs, pivots, leaps, stirs sediment with its feet, and spreads or canopies its wings to shade, startle, and herd small fish. Usually forages alone but may join mixed feeding groups.
field_marks: Long neck, sturdy blue-gray legs, broad wings, and a short tail
Conspicuously shaggy head and neck plumes
Dark morph has a slate-gray body with a rusty cinnamon head and neck
Heavy, straight, daggerlike bill; breeding adults show a pink base and black tip
Pale yellow eye, with blue to violet facial skin most evident in breeding plumage
habitat: Shallow coastal wetlands, especially tidal flats, salt marshes, lagoons, protected bays and estuaries, salt pans, mangrove flats, and barrier-island shores; occasional freshwater ponds. Nests colonially in mangroves, shrubs, low beach vegetation, or on the ground.
